entry.title: New: Bill 145 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Bill 145, Draft 3 Failed - 06/19/24
entry.content:
INITIATES AN AMENDMENT TO ARTICLE VI, CHAPTER 7, SECTIONS 6-7.3 AND 6-7.4; AND ARTICLE XVI OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CHARTER (2022 EDITION), RELATING TO THE WINDWARD AND LEEWARD PLANNING COMMISSIONS

Adds a requirement that at least one member of each commission have experience or expertise in Native Hawaiian traditional and customary practices, Native Hawaiian law, or traditional Hawaiian land usage; climate resilience, natural resource management, or agricultural sustainability; or environmental science, environmental protection, or land conservation, and that each category be represented by a different member.

Latest action: Council: Bill 145, Draft 3 Failed - 06/19/24
